note: YWHAZ variants cause Popov-Chang syndrome with CFC-like features, making the assessment of ectodermal manifestation differences versus classical CFC a clinically plausible differentiator worth investigating.

evidence.text: Cardiofaciocutaneous syndrome is caused by heterozygous variants in genes such as BRAF, MAP2K1, MAP2K2, KRAS, or rarely YWHAZ, with characteristic ectodermal, cardiac, and craniofacial involvement.

source.title: The Cardiofaciocutaneous Syndrome: From Genetics to ...
source.quote: It is an autosomal dominant syndrome, with complete penetrance, caused by heterozygous pathogenic variants in the genes BRAF, MAP2K1/MEK1, MAP2K2/MEK2, KRAS or, rarely, YWHAZ, all part of the RAS-MAPK pathway.

evidence.text: The S230W gain-of-function variant in YWHAZ was identified in individuals with a phenotype consistent with CFC syndrome.

source.title: A YWHAZ Variant Associated With Cardiofaciocutaneous ...
source.quote: We recently identified novel variants in YWHAZ, a 14-3-3 family member, in individuals with a phenotype consistent with CFC that may potentially be deleterious and disease-causing.
